column3: MT 34:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm,” and “when he changed his sense” is rendered “when he pretended madness.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְעָנָנִי (“answered me”) is rendered “He heard me.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV renders the verbs as past (“They looked… were not ashamed”).
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies the subject “The righteous.”
Close to the Hebrew; “crushed of spirit” is rendered “a contrite spirit.”
Close to the Hebrew; יֶאְשָׁמוּ (“be held guilty”) is rendered “shall be condemned.”
